description: Verify behavior, integrations and performance and review whether the change is correct and maintainable.

interface.shortDescription: Tests, browser QA and code reviews.
interface.longDescription:
Verify behavior, integrations and performance and review whether the change is correct and maintainable.

Covers: Testing, Browser QA, Performance, Code review/quality gates.

Expected outputs: Test strategy and automated checks; Browser QA evidence; Performance measurements; Code review and quality-gate findings.

Original skills used through Engineering Core: superpowers:test-driven-development, wshobson:e2e-testing-patterns, gstack:qa-only, addy:browser-testing-with-devtools, addy:performance-optimization, vercel:react-best-practices, addy:code-review-and-quality, superpowers:verification-before-completion.

Optional specialist and framework packs: browser-playwright, advanced-testing, terraform, observability, expo, product-delivery, intent-audit, agent-engineering, vue, svelte, angular, next-cache, gsap, react-native-performance, swiftui, android-ui, kotlin-mobile, backend-fastify, backend-fastapi, backend-django, backend-apollo, backend-rust, jobs-inngest, api-contract-testing, search-algolia, security-audit, xylex-code-audit. These are selected for the project when relevant; they are not all enabled by default.

Declared integrations: context7, sentry, github. These are integration recipes, not connected services; configure the corresponding tools and accounts separately.

Why the app shows one skill: this plugin exposes one entry skill which loads the relevant original specialists from Engineering Core on demand. The Skills count in the app is not the size of the shared upstream library.

Requires Engineering Core (finem-core). Tasks spanning multiple disciplines may also require the corresponding area plugins.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this project for Testing & Quality and recommend the relevant original skills and framework packs.
Review Testing & Quality in this project and prioritize concrete improvements with verification steps.
